items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: But Bix was, I liked the musical sound of his tone. And also his choice of notes, his taste, his harmony.

ctx.x: My own band yes. And it was made around 1956 I think it was. It was more or less a tribute to Bix Beiderbecke. Those are numbers that he did. And that was one of them.
Well since you mentioned that, name (LAUGHTER) we just have to go right on to Bix right here because certainly when we talk of writers we always think in terms, in terms of their influences.
